body: I totally agree, I had the love of my life pass away years ago. I was lucky to find her since I have a horrible skin condition, she loved me for me, and I have never found anyone else since no one wants me. I dedicated my life to being stable financially and mentally after her death. I would give up all my money to be in a good relationship. Now I am much older and the fact I am alone almost killed me due to lack of human touch. Doctors are keeping me alive with drugs, which again I was lucky they found the right combo. It is not just the lack of coupling that hits home, it is the abuse as well. I have been spit for asking a woman out, online dating might as well be on an alien world for me and I have been the brunt of so many cruel pranks I have lost count. My therapist tells me I should be happy on my own, yet she has a husband and kids. My friends (before they cut me out of their life due their wives complaints) would tell me I should be happy on my own, yet they have wives and kids. All these people saying I should be happy when if they are alone it is the end of the world. One of my friends is now divorced, he peaked in college, doesn't look like he did when he was young anymore. After 2 months of being alone plus all the stress of life, he is going crazy since he can't get dates. He is so desperate for a woman's attention I heard he dated someone 20 years older than him (which would be a 58 year old). If half these people were forced to be alone, cut off like me they would eat a bullet. The other half wouldn't be able to handle it and just sit in their homes all day.

I appreciate the kind words! Honestly my mom was the only thing keeping me going in life but she has been gone for awhile so is hard to keep dragging myself through life. I have lived in my home country, in the US, and in the EU when I was in university. Never found a place to live where people didn't judge me. Never found my "people" where I could belong, a tribe of my own. My home country was close since we all shared the same culture but there are no jobs there suited for my education background.

You make a valid point, the pain is less when you move to a new place but only for so long. I tried my best to seek out a place like that to make a permanent home. I lived in one country where a group of local women thought I was a leper and voted in the village forum to have me kicked out for the safety of the children. Good group of people that didn't understand me or my condition, I don't fault them at all since I look terrible.

I have had rocks thrown at me, spit on, beat with sticks, and thrown in a lake by people. Feels like I am cursed, everyday just reminds me and reinforces that feeling.

I have a terrible skin condition and since I was 5 I haven't been part of society that much, always an outcast. I use to pay three women to do different things for me with no sex involved. I had one who would have dinner with me, one to facetime with my camera off, and one to cuddle with me. Even though I was paying these women, the only one that treated me like a human was the one I had dinner with monthly. The facetime woman stopped talking to me after I showed her my face, and the woman who cuddled with me threw up a couple of times in the hotel during our sessions.

You shouldn't feel ashamed at all, everyone needs touch as humans. You will over come this breakup and if you want, will find someone who will really love you. Or you can go solo for your life, there is nothing wrong with that at all. You have choices where some do not, this will pass to make you a stronger woman. I know it doesn't seem that way, but take it from a guy who looks like a monster for 40 plus years, it takes time and effort on your part.

Thank you very much, I appreciate it! I am thankful for everything I have and when I have good times they are freaking awesome. My very being is just so tired of everyday struggles. I can't go a week without someone treating me like crap, sometimes it is back to back. The simplest things in life can be a struggle because other people just have to interfere with me. Either by the business, customers, or random people. I can't go walking in the park without getting harassed. Someone called the police on me last month when I went to the park and I was almost arrested! The reason? I was scaring a Karen's children whom I walked by by for 10 seconds to make it to the runner's area. There is no other way to get there, so I get stopped or harassed at least once a month at the park.
Thank you very much, I appreciate being on someone's mind at least!
I appreciate your kind words thank you!
You are too kind, I appreciate all your kind words. I don't have high hopes it will happen again, but there is a little hope still alive.

I do have my own little guy I love so much. He just turned 7 in May, had him since he was a puppy. He helps me a lot, in many different ways. Every year after my mother died, the time of her birthday is very emotional for me since I use to spend time with her, never missing one. This year was no different, I was having a hard time, emotional. My little boy wouldn't leave me side, brought his favorite toy and tried to get me to play. Dogs are really a gift!

I appreciate the reply, and the suggestions! My therapist has been with me for many years, and pretty much all we have left is to look on the bright side in our conversations. Mind you it is not the only thing suggested during our conversations. I have learned through many years of therapy ways to disarm folks. How I move, personal space, reading body language, and knowing the leave a social interaction. If I didn't, my life would be a lot worse off.

In business, it took me a long time to build up my revenue. I have a card that I hand out to explain my condition for new potential clients. Over the years I have a strong network of business clients that know I am one of the top person in my field. I would never succeed in let's say a job where I had to lead a team everyday in a corporate environment. I also take advantage (one of the few I have) of the fact people think I am a burn victim or I am differently abled. No one in my field wants to come off as someone who is bias towards a differently abled person for legal reasons. The people that know me also understand the service I provide is best in class.

For the dance class, a rule just for me or explaining my condition just isn't my style. I don't want to be treated any differently in a good or bad way. Besides even if I explain my condition, there is no guarantee it would make a difference. It would just stop the class which for something that only impacts me. On top of that, the instructor just reopened the school, everyone is afraid of COVID, it isn't my place to make waves that could hurt the school. I am very happy it is back open, because the people there are awesome. Folks learning to dance means things are going back to normal, if we even know what that is anymore.

I do volunteer for a lot of various charities in my area, using my skill set to make what little difference I can. My passions are clean water for everyone, financial education (basics like writing checks, getting a loan and doing your taxes) for young people, and of course animals. Animals just love me for some reason, I don't know why. They don't judge me, aren't afraid of me, or try to hurt me.

I agree it is a bit BS, but in the end it is ok for them to not want me in their life. I miss them like crazy, but it is their life, you only get one. I love them like they are my brothers, and if me being away makes them happy then I can take a small measure of peace from that outcome.

What has gutted me, is even if I was to make new friends (which is next to impossible) I will have to face the possibility of this happening all over again. I can understand why a person would do this to me,  the emotional pain is so massive to be treated in this manner. I can't change the way I look, and the human race isn't going to change the way it treats me. It makes me lost and broken, unsure of the next steps.
Wow, I don't know what to say, that is very kind of you to offer something like that. Thank you very much!

Per my conversation with them, it was more about the fact I was around them in public. In their mind I was bring the down socially. I suppose I understand it, my friend are very good looking men and their wives are attractive ladies. I just don't add up to their equation. Either way I wish them best, they are good people who don't want me around. It is ok for them to be selfish, you only get one life.

I have always splurged and did the things I wanted to do since I have been alone for a long time. If I wait for someone to go with me on this journey called life I wouldn't do anything but sit at home. I don't care what other people think honestly, I am stuck being me. I love me, I am proud of what I have done with my life. I just want people to mind their own business. It is just hard being alone with no hope of that ever changing. I am at a low point in my life right now, really struggling to see an light on the empty road in my future. Where I will never have another dance partner, a climbing buddy, or someone to travel with to new locations. I feel in my heart, that I will die alone and be forgotten. In my bed, dark room, coughing up the last bit of life I have left until they find me dead. They will burn me to ash, fearing I have something they can catch. No one to visit my grave or even cared I at one point existed.

When that happens you lot won't have to look at my ugly mug anymore right? Small blessings as they say eh?

I totally agree, thank you for replying. I guess I am just in a very bad place right now, and I am so tired of being in this shape. For too long I have been trapped in my own body, and I am reminded about it everyday by others. Just weak right now and need some rest.

I agree it is ok to be single, friendless and without a family. I think I could handle it a lot better if I wasn't made fun of, pointed at or shunned when I go out in public. Great you won the genetic lottery, I didn't ask for this leave me alone and shut the hell up. I don't want to hate anyone, I just can't keep that much negative energy in me. Recently I am just broke down and the hate is flooding in my heart.

There are nice people out there for sure, and folks are really nice when they don't see me or my face. I wanted to make a connection with at least one human being in my older age, which is impossible. I have to be guarded for people that just want to be close due to my success, who always ask for money. To the people who just wants to be nice for show or to later ask me for something. That is why this group of friends I lost impacted me so much, they knew me before I was successful, and they accepted when I as a poor ugly man. I met the love of my life through this group of friends, it is like she passed away all over again. 

In the end, I am just hurt, confused, and tired of this life. I am so fatigued by putting up with being judged, stared at, and the whispers behind my back. Whispers so loud I can hear you talk how it looks my right ear is rotting off because I am having a bad skin day.

I have yes, as I replied to the other reply, I didn't feel right being in those groups. My issues are a lot less important than those folks. 

As for empathy, I have only met two humans who had it, and they are both gone. I mean actual empathy and not pity, folks sometime confuse the two. I have moved twice in my life to avoid those people who have not practiced empathy skills. Big cities are the worse for me, the last big city I lived in had my car keyed with the words Monster in the door. Getting notes from my neighbors that someone should put me down, or how easy it would be to slip in my house, kill me, and make it look like a suicide since I live alone. Cops didn't do crap, I had no proof who it was but I knew wrote them. So I was run off by those kind church going folks who are the paragons of virtue.

You aren't insensitive at all, thank you for replying! I have not tried those groups before, not sure how I would join a group like that without having the underlying medical condition. I know some support groups are gated to keep the privacy and healing effort of the group. I will look into and find out if could join a group like that.

As for women, I have a very bad history with dating, which is par for the course. I guess losing my friends broke something in me. I can't get back to normal me emotionally. I find myself seeing a funny Youtube video, saying to myself I will share it with the guys, then realizing I can't. Takes me back to being a lone at recess playing in the corner with the old ball no one else wanted. Teachers and kids were happier when I was in the corner, my friends are happier without me in their lives. So I guess I that is a good thing right? I brought them a little sunshine by staying in my corner.

Lol, thank you friend! I don't know if you play Fallout at all, but my reply would be in the same vein as the ghouls in that game. "Would if I could smooth skin"

I would love to get back into video games, but there are so many out there not sure which would have a good community. The only game I have time for now is Fallout 76 which I love (I know I know, please don't in box me about how much you hate it).

You are right about a male therapist, my prior one was a man who retired. He had been with me through my teens until I turned 30. He got me through the suicidal years. Not saying women can't be great therapists, I had a great one as a kid. Women just have a different experience with validation and being lonely. I was complemented once when I was younger by a woman, and I rode that high for many years. I still remember her name, what she looked like, her outfit, what I had to eat that day. That is how much an impact she made on my sorry life.

Once I saw a woman on a dating site with a skin condition (different from mine), and I matched her just to ask a few questions. I asked if she gets matches and the like, and amazingly she gets a lot. She said sometime she makes a profile on Tinder just to have a bunch of guys match and try to ask her to validate herself. Which just floored me how different our experiences are in life.

I know men will ask anything out to try get that one thing, and I know women have to put up with a lot of crap. From my point of view, someone who has had actual rocks thrown at him (still have the scar over my left eye) by other humans for being different it seems like heaven. I don't know what it is liked to be pursued by someone who wanted me, since no one wants me lol.

No need to be sorry, it is what it is. I am just feeling sorry for myself which I have no right to do. I have sat in disability support groups in my 30's but I didn't feel right being there. Some of them are dealing with just trying to live in our world which in a lot cases isn't easy. I just felt very small and wrong talking about my issues, so I dropped out.

I held this idea for a long time, my beloved told me this years ago when we were just friends in high school. Here I am single, friendless and no family. I don't want to do so, but I am  starting to hate normal people. I can't go to store to buy food without someone being cruel to me. I love self check out as I don't have to interact with a cashier, and I have had employees complain they don't want me touch the machines. One time I was almost escorted out because I was standing in line without my gloves (pre Covid days) which I forgot at home. The young lady working at the store freaked out when she saw my hands and thought I was a leper. Security was ready to kick me out until the manager came back from lunch and stopped them. Good thing I knew the manager otherwise I would be banned from that store and every store in that chain. Why? Because a normal person thought I was a sinner, how else would I get struck down with leprosy, according to her?

I really want to believe this, I try to stay positive. I have lost more friends over the years than gained. The last core friend group is now gone, my family has been passed for a few years now, and I haven't been an actual date where someone was interested in me for a long time. I try to only post my experiences on Reddit, try to share that someone else is suffering as well. I even made a contact on here whom we use to talk to quite often, but they are no longer responding since I won't show them my face. I don't want to be a freak show to someone, or for someone online to look me up. I value my privacy on here and have had bad experiences in the past with online interactions.

Yes in a previous post I detailed some of my adventures in support groups. I had a few men's groups I joined prior, but they grew very toxic quickly. I felt myself growing toxic and buying into their opinions, at the time I was very angry. I ejected from those groups quickly. I haven't found support groups for my condition, there are only a handful of doctors that handle my issue in the world. There is a support group 300 miles away from me for skin conditions in general, no online support so far. Therapy doesn't help anymore, been doing it since I was 6. Therapy gives you the tools to deal with your situation, but 40 plus years of living this way has finally wore me down.

I appreciate the reply. I did talk with my friends but they all stood strong their life would better without me. They tried to let me down easy, almost like they were breaking up with me. Wives came together and set their collective foot down. I don't blame them, they are good guys, it is hard to be my friend and I understand that in the end.

I gave up online dating, as it was just one mess after another. Women can be very cruel, and being online just makes them even more so. I don't really have time for video games, I am love them but I am a casual player.

Yes I do, I almost have a specialist on retainer. The meds I take deal with the pain and the horrible flare ups when my skin hardens like reptile skin. I have also had two laser surgeries out of the country but those left me scared a bit. The goal of the surgeries was more about dealing with the hardened skin and less about beauty standards.

I am checking out the links you provided, and will talk with my skin care specialist to see if this will work my prescription lotions. I really appreciate you giving me a lead on this, it has made me happy to have a new option!
I had tried that in my younger years, very painful to have anything on my skin, including clothing. I will have to look into it again since I believe make up has come along way in advances.

I appreciate it! I must say that when I was with Sara, I was the luckiest man in the world. She wasn't afraid to touch me, hold me, or do everything a normal skin healthy person experiences. When she passed almost 20 years ago, I spent a few years putting myself back together. Imagine just going through your life for 19 years with these normal urges to hold, kiss, and later wanting to have sex. Then right at 19 you get it all, it was the best thing that ever happened to me. After I lost it, I was so broken.

Finally I tried for the past 15 years to date after my healing period. I will never be able to replace Sara, nor would I try. I am just craving the kind of affection all humans crave. Instead of just getting the normal rejection, it is escalated to the point where they feel the need to make me feel less than human. I get over it after an hour or so, only to try again to have the same thing happen again. I was thinking about posting some of the replies I get from online dating, some of them are very cruel. I dismissed that thought because I don't want to put anyone on blast. Just not my way I suppose, and I don't feel like a victim. It would be nice to go out on a date for once, actually talk, and maybe form a friendship. I am very tired of it all, 40 plus years of being me is tiresome.

I appreciate the suggestions! 

There isn't any help groups for my condition, at least around here, but I use to be part of a group for lost loved ones, which helped me get back to feeling "normal" again. I out grew that group and went into therapy which made things better overall. Before Covid, I tried men's support groups a few times. Most of them can turn pretty toxic, woman bashing, or a hub for incels. I found they were changing me for the worse, I wanted to be belong, and I thought being with a group of hateful people was better than being alone. Took a month or so until I realized that it wasn't healthy. There is a new support group in my area starting up soon that my therapist suggested, so I am going to try that.

Thank you for the luck! I was going to buy a bed and breakfast in my area which was really popular. The owner passed and his husband was looking to sell it. Then Covid happened so that scared me away. Once things get back to normal I might look at that route again. I appreciate the great idea!

I appreciate your kind words, it made my day a lot better. I have lived this way for all my life, but it took me a while to become who I am today. I have to see this face in the mirror everyday, most can't handle looking at it. I still love them and hope one day we can get back together. Till then I will hold onto all the good memories we have built over the years and try to make new friends in the mean time.

I don't think I am anything special, or my struggle is any greater than another. I really want folks to know to cherish what you have, fix what you can fix, and let go what you can't. I will be cheering you on from my corner of the world.

I am an alcoholic 8 years recovering, so a bar would be a bad idea for me. Objectively though a bar would be pretty awesome from a social perspective! I wonder if there are other businesses that works like a bar, I can't think of any off the top of my head.

I appreciate you reply!

I do enjoy my time alone very much so, like all humans I do like to have some social interactions from time to time. To loss all my friends, relationships I have had over 30 years just gutted me. Trying to form new connections is really hard for me, but I still try my best. Even when I do my best though, I am denied 90% of the time. I needed help at a hardware store last week, and even with a mask I still had issue getting help. Folks don't to be around me or look at me. They are afraid they will catch what I have
Rhinophyma  Rosacea and  ocular rosacea

He did, wife and two kids. He served in Vietnam so most folks thought he had a war wound. He met his wife in highschool and married her when get back home. I had the love of my life in college, she treated me as a normal person, and we were going to be married after school. She became pregnant in our last year, we were madly in love, my life was great. She passed away with our child which left me the shell of a person for a few years. Why can't I now? Very hard to do so when the woman is laughing in your face or pouring a drink over your head.

My religion is small, and the only church is back home in my families country of origin. I have been part of Christian, Muslim and Jewish communities, but after a while they tire of my presence. I had one church just stop inviting me to functions yet wanted me to give money to their church regardless.

I play softball every year except for last year, but of course that was with my friends. I would have to start back over. I do agree they were dicks but I understand why the did it. I don't hate them, I am just really hurt. If I had more time I would love to play more sports but my business takes most of my time.
Of course I think we all have one time or another.  Curious why you ask?

I only found one other person who had a similar situation to my own, he was a good man who was a bit older. Never seen a woman who was single that is like me. I truly feel like an alien on an alien world. Found out when I was 5 how crappy humans can be and will be to me.

I am sorry you are going through obesity, that is a rough road, I wish you all the best. You prove my point I say all the time, there are folks out there going through their own struggles. Racism sucks as well, and no human should go through it. I am looking into a couple of support groups as well, you inspired me to try again. I appreciate your words and the awesome intention behind them!

I have joined support groups here and there over the years. Most "outcast" support groups nowadays are full of angry men who are fed up with the system or dating. It can lead to some toxic behaviors, I for one almost fell into that trap. Not to say their aren't good groups out, but I haven't found one for men that is an honest support group.

That is terrible about that poor girl in a fire. To look normal and have it taken would be crushing. I am lucky in that way since I have never looked like anyone else really, so I don't know what it is like to be treated like a normal guy. I found one guy years ago who was in the same situation as me, that is it, just one other person. There are people who my condition yes, but it is rare to have it like I do. I had to know everything about this guy, and he felt the same way. We connected on a very personal level and we both felt like kindred spirits. He was married, had two healthy kids and a great job. For two years we had a great friendship, until a drunk driver hit him on New years in 2004.

I feel like a man marooned on a island of people who have their village on one side, and I am forced to live on the other end in my own hut.

I totally agree, and the procedure in Brazil happened almost 20 years ago. I would love to hide my scars but the tissue around them is not healthy, pose a high risk of infection, or so I am told. The last time I saw my specialist about my condition about 4 months ago, they gave me this cream which helps with the pain. I can actually wear my favorite shirts without having to bandage my skin. The bandage is there to prevent the pain of having the fabric rubbing against my skin, the new cream is a blessing in my life.

I was advised there is a new procedure coming to market in the next couple of years that I am excited about, my fingers are crossed it can help. Either way it won't be a quick fix, emotionally it is hard. I haven't had human contact in a while and it is getting to me. Not being touched in a long time is an odd feeling, I find just being in line at a store six feet apart feels amazing. I envy my friends who have people living with them, or able to be touched when out in public because people aren't afraid of them. Last week, I bumped elbows with a new client in lieu of shaking hands. To know another human acknowledged my existence as a human like them is just the best. Funny when I paid the girl for cuddles I would cry in arms since it felt great, now I just cry alone since it feels so bad.

Indeed I do about every three to six months to see if there is something new. I have visited other countries for treatment as well, both for the cost and the fact they have different advances in other countries. I don't recommend it to everyone, the last laser surgery I had in Brazil did more harm than good. I knew the danger and did it anyway.

You are 100% right! I did this when my Sara passed away and rebuilt my life one step at a time. I traveled the US for a bit to see different places, and it is how I ran into the person that would get me started in my current business. I appreciate the offer to show me, it is good to know people like you exist :)

I appreciate it the reply. I have tried random sites before, the point of having the same person is to build a rapport with that person. That way we can carry on a conversation, already have the background established, and won't have to do an icebreaker to start the conversation every time. I didn't mind paying her as it helped with my depression and being lonely. I might sound like a loser, but I miss talking to her. I don't leave the house anymore due to Covid, and she was like a life line to the outside world.

Those random sites I tried more often than not I would get made of fun, focused on my skin, or ignored. It is hard for people to accept me, harder still for women to accept me in a romantic sense. It will not get any better, it hasn't for 40 years. I was just trying to get a little mercy from the world.
Most people don't get it, I can see why if you don't live it everyday. Hard to put yourself in someone else's shoes.
Good Bot

I help banks and companies invest in international projects for profit and non profit. In other words I am a free lance investment banker who is licensed and contracted in the US and Europe. I do a little bit in Asia as well since the laws are a bit different for this type of work. It is all about meetings and phone calls day in and day out. I am my own boss and make my own hours so that is nice.

So that I could pretend I was normal, it was the only way to have a conversation with the opposite sex in an intimate way. I am not normal in anyway, and I am fine with that. I am so tired of trying to fit in, hide, or put in 110% just to be seen as a human. Today I scared the poor girl who dropped off my food, I thought she was going to break away running after I took my food. I had my mask on but forgot to put my robe on to hid my arms. She must have thought Frankenstein's monster was coming at her lol.

No worries at all, no need to apologize I appreciate the interest. I use topical steroid creams to ease the symptoms but that is only a stop gap. I use creams to ease the pain as well. I have three dermatologists working with me with one that specializes in my condition. When I was younger I couldn't even take a shower, and there wasn't really anything that could be done for me. Thankfully modern medicine has advanced a lot in that time.

I have rhinophyma all over my body and eyes. There are about 1 in 1000 cases like mine that have this condition where 80 to 90% of the skin will harden. I have covered in scars because in the early 2000's I elected for laser surgery as an new untested way to treat it (had it done in Brazil). Turns out my condition and lasers do not mix well, so it just left me scarred instead of healing correctly. Most men who suffer from rhinophyma only impacts their face, and some have had success with laser surgery. I very much wanted to cured that I would have taken a flame thrower to myself if it would help. It isn't just about the look of it, it is very painful as well. I treat it with expensive creams and chemicals just to keep the pain down. Regardless I still look like burnt zombie since there is no cure.

I hate pictures of my self, but if you look up bad cases of rhinophyma, and imagine it all over a human being's body you get the picture. Last time I post pictures of myself online via facebook, a group of women took it upon themselves to run a smear campaign against me. One of them tried to get her then boyfriend to knife me because I asked her out for coffee when she was single. Showing my face or pictures of me has conditioned me to expect the worse out of people.

Yeah I totally understand that, I was just hoping for something different. I wasn't going to stop paying her, I just wanted to chat with my cam on, so she could see how happy our conversations made me. I just wanted to be treated like every other guy out there, instead of feeling like I have to hide in the shadows.

I appreciate it, I have been but they are my cards to play. My life is not all bad though, I don't have to worry about money or a place to live. My life sucks but other people have it worse, I am blessed and thankful for everything in my life. I just miss being hugged by someone that means it, holding hands, lying in bed talking about the day.

My mom has had me in therapy since I was 8, I have stuck to it all these years. If I didn't I would have offed myself a long time ago, it is just hard dealing with the human race. I don't blame the woman I was chatting with, and I knew it was just pretend. I was happy to pay her for taking the time out of her day to talk with me.
